## How it works

<h3>Try it</h3><ol><li>Orbit, pan or zoom to the view you want to share.</li><li>Click Create link, then Copy link or Download BCF. Open view reopens the shared BCF topic.</li><li>The same pinned model loads and the saved BCF view is restored.</li></ol>
<h3>Developer integration</h3><p><code>viewer.createTopic(undefined, { snapshot: false })</code> captures the current view in a BCF 3.0 archive. <code>bcf.save()</code> writes the same standard BCF bytes used by the download and the URL fragment. The optional snapshot is omitted to keep links smaller. <code>bcf.load()</code> validates the archive before <code>viewer.add()</code> and <code>viewer.selectTopic(id)</code> restore it. The URL encoding belongs to this page; the BCF payload follows buildingSMART BCF-XML. Large selections or image attachments can exceed the link limit; download the BCF file in that case.</p><p>Copy this HTML and serve it over HTTP. The pinned SDK and model download require internet access.</p>
